correctness.rationale: For every SPD M-matrix elimination, positive Schur pivots and negative offdiagonals exclude sign cancellation; exact neighbors are completed to a clique. The first monochromatic part-run deterministically controls the number of absent intra-part pairs remaining after a second part is touched. Sampling without replacement gives the falling-factorial joint law, pair timing gives the expectation, monotonic deficits give extrema, and a dominated geometric run law gives convergence of variances. A standalone exact-rational permutation/Schur checker passed 2,231 grouped assertions; the finite checks are auxiliary to the complete proof.

value.rationale: The full distribution for a natural structured sparse-direct-solver model quantifies exact fill storage, not merely a few illustrative instances. The probability of maximal fill tends to a positive constant while minimum-fill orders become exponentially rare, with precise geometric fluctuations and sharp expectation-versus-optimum ratio. These are quantitative reference limits for judging the effect of elimination ordering, without claiming broader numerical complexity or superiority over other solvers.
